findings.title: Explicit empty --base still produces a successful NOT_REQUIRED receipt
findings.cause: The CLI guards comparison with if args.base, so an explicitly supplied empty string bypasses _git_changed_paths and its new nonempty-base validation.
findings.requirement: Invalid Git comparisons must fail closed rather than become an empty changed-path set.
findings.recommended_fix: Distinguish omitted base from explicitly supplied empty base with args.base is not None; add a CLI-level regression while retaining changed-file-only invocation.
findings.reachability_limit: Existing .github/workflows/ci.yml already validates a nonzero exact 40-hex reachable comparison base for push and pull_request events. This finding does not establish a bypass of that current CI shell guard.
